relationMerges.rationale: The retired Midway row's Harrison Street period is an asset-level instance of Harrison Street's continuing ownership in the same Harrison Street–1547 platform; the canonical platform period began with the partnership's first 2020 acquisition and remains active.

rationale: Merge the standalone Midway Technology Centre record into the existing Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform. Direct transaction-party evidence establishes that Midway/CHIL1 was one of four facilities sold by CIM Group to the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture on November 2, 2021, with 1547 continuing as manager. Preserve Midway Technology Centre, Midway Technology Center and CHIL1 as facility aliases, retain the platform's separate Harrison Street and 1547 ownership periods, and do not infer Harrison Street ownership of corporate 1547, a Harrison Street Digital Fund attribution, or an ownership exit from the facility's live sale marketing. No buyer or later closing was identified through August 19, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: The Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform is a U.S. portfolio of carrier-neutral data centers and interconnection facilities held through asset-level joint ventures and operated by FifteenFortySeven Critical Systems Realty. The partnership began with its September 3, 2020 acquisition of the Wells carrier hotel in Milwaukee and later expanded through properties including Midway Technology Centre (CHIL1), Pittock Block, AlohaNAP, DRFortress and facilities in Chicago, Orangeburg, Wyoming, Michigan, South Bend and McAllen. 1547 reports more than 1.25 million square feet under management. Harrison Street and 1547 are current co-owners, but exact platform stakes, the Harrison Street fund and any umbrella legal entity are not publicly disclosed. Corporate 1547 is the operator and sponsor rather than a company proven to be owned by Harrison Street, and the individual facilities are assets within the platform. Midway has been marketed for sale, but no buyer, signed transfer or closing was identified through August 19, 2026; no platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified.

set.event: CIM Group sold Midway/CHIL1, CHIL2, ORNY1 and CHWY1 to the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture, expanding the partnership to six data centers while 1547 remained manager.
